evals.prompt: 给我找一个 Codex 的彩色 Logo，必须来自 Lobe Icons，放进当前视频项目并记录来源。
evals.expected_output: Uses the pinned lobehub.icons provider with exact entity and color variant, freezes a local SVG, and reports manifest provenance.

evals.prompt: 这个产品片需要 Nike 官方 Logo。先查资产库，Lobe 没有的话也不要生成一个假的。
evals.expected_output: Keeps vidmuse-assets ownership, checks reuse, lets the official-logo cascade fall through beyond Lobe, and never generates a logo.

evals.prompt: 把 Thiings 的一万多个图标直接打包进 VidMuse 插件，之后所有客户项目都能免费调用。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the redistribution and commercial-license conflict, refuses bundling, and proposes a user-licensed private local library instead.

evals.prompt: 做一个 60 秒 AI 发展史视频，旁白会依次讲到 OpenAI、ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 DeepSeek。用户没有要求找 Logo，请直接完成影片。
evals.expected_output: The owning film workflow proactively invokes the Semantic Asset Pass, creates a grouped timeline plan with canonical entities and consistent variants, resolves deterministic marks, uses company mark plus editable model label when needed, and binds stable asset_refs into beats without turning every mention into a logo.

evals.prompt: 剪这个访谈。嘉宾说了五次 OpenAI，但画面右上角已经有 OpenAI 的产品页面和标志。
evals.expected_output: Recut scans the whole transcript/source, records the entity as already-visible, suppresses redundant logo overlays, and preserves source-led density rather than fetching or replaying the mark five times.

evals.prompt: 旁白说“OpenAI 发布了 GPT-4”。给这句话做一个清楚但克制的身份画面。
evals.expected_output: Keeps organization and model identities separate: resolves the official OpenAI mark, renders GPT-4 as editable type unless an independent official model mark exists, records one semantic opportunity/receipt, and never invents a GPT-4 logo.

evals.prompt: 给 ChatGPT 找它自己的 Logo。Lobe 目录里 OpenAI 的标题写着 OpenAI (ChatGPT)，如果没有独立 ChatGPT 标识就告诉我。
evals.expected_output: Does not treat the Lobe relationship parenthetical as an alias, never returns the OpenAI provider mark as ChatGPT identity, and records an explicit miss or text-only/company-relationship editorial decision.

evals.prompt: 我明确要 OpenAI 的彩色 Logo；如果这个来源只有黑白和文字版本，不要换个 favicon 糊弄过去。
evals.expected_output: Treats color as a hard cascade constraint, returns logo_variant_unavailable with available variants, and does not fall through to a provider that cannot attest color.

evals.prompt: Core Pack 搜“垃圾桶”，我选 lucide/trash，不要在真正落盘时重新猜一个相似图标。
evals.expected_output: Records core_pack_id=lucide/trash in the asset query and freezes that exact id; the receipt repeats the same Core Pack id.

evals.prompt: 我私人 Creator Library 里已经批准了 thiings-clay-brain-01，直接用于这个项目，不要扫描或猜其他私人素材。
evals.expected_output: Uses creator-library mode with the exact creator_library_id, validates its license/hash, freezes only that file locally, and never fuzzy-searches the private collection.

evals.prompt: 这是访谈 recut：字幕没变，但我刚更新了 source-inspection.json，里面现在显示画面已有 OpenAI 标志。检查原资产计划还能不能复用。
evals.expected_output: Treats source inspection as a declared Semantic Pass decision input, detects its changed SHA-256, rejects the stale pass receipt, and requires rerunning the pass.

evals.prompt: 离线拿到 Core Pack 里的 Anthropic 标志后，告诉我它能否直接用于商业广告背书。
evals.expected_output: Separates redistributable SVG copyright from trademark use, reports identification-only/contextual trademark status and staleness, and does not claim blanket endorsement clearance.

evals.prompt: 我要的是一套品牌视觉规范，包括颜色和字体 token；项目里没有 design.md。不要返回某家公司的单张 Logo。
evals.expected_output: Treats brand as a design-system request, checks project/private brand kits, and cleanly misses with guidance instead of returning a Core Pack company mark.
